# Shunno O Oshim

> Shunno O Oshim is an independent niche perfume house creating natural fragrances from rare oud, animalic musk, and botanical extracts.

## Primary pages

- [The Garden](https://www.byshunno.com/garden): Current niche perfume collection and product stories.
- [Manifesto](https://www.byshunno.com/Manifesto): The house's approach to natural perfumery and raw materials.
- [Archive](https://www.byshunno.com/randoms): Archived work from Shunno O Oshim.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.byshunno.com/policy): Website and purchase terms.

## Brand facts

- Brand name: Shunno O Oshim
- Category: Independent natural niche perfumes
- Materials: Rare wild oud, animalic musk, and botanical extracts
- Website: https://www.byshunno.com/
